subfamily: Scotch Old-Fashioned, built on one large cube; elderflower liqueur beside the Codex's teaspoon of syrup
glass: small tumbler (rocks glass, about 250 ml), one large ice cube
_status: v1 (Tomas, round 4; _status scoped round 5), story ruled by Wren r3 (George Smith, Hester's card). Old-Fashioned root (Codex pp. 3-6; 'any modifications should enhance the characteristics of that spirit', p. 6). Spark: elderflower liqueur (style) turning up the 12's own floral side (Codex p. 204, the 12's paragraph: 'elegant and floral, with a touch of honey'). The general single-malt paragraph's 'amplify the heather... St-Germain' (p. 204) is not about the 12: never quoted as a suggestion for it. 5 ml rich syrup = the Codex Ideal Old-Fashioned's 1 tsp (p. 5). Passion fruit set aside: OUT on acid built (0.10%). Elderflower alone without syrup: sugar OUT (2.84 g).
